videos.title: Logan Lucky
videos.description: Two brothers attempt to pull off a heist during a Nascar race in North Carolina. Crime caper, starring Channing Tatum and Adam Driver.

videos.title: Mamma Mia!
videos.description: A bride asks three of her mother's old flames to her wedding to learn which of them is her father. Musical comedy featuring Abba songs, starring Meryl Streep and Pierce Brosnan.

videos.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
videos.description: The half-witted duo meet for the first time and band together to make it through the perils of high school. Comedy prequel, starring Eric Christian Olsen and Derek Richardson.

videos.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
videos.description: Recently widowed Bridget enters the dating game again, caught between her son's science teacher and a younger man. Romantic comedy, starring Renee Zellweger.

videos.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
videos.description: A blind man and his deaf friend go on the run to escape a trumped-up murder charge and crooks tracking down a top-secret microchip. Comedy, starring Richard Pryor and Gene Wilder.

videos.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
videos.description: Newsreader Ron Burgundy becomes the star of a 24-hour news channel with a series of sensationalist stories. Comedy sequel, starring Will Ferrell and Christina Applegate.

videos.title: Shaun of the Dead
videos.description: An aimless man decides to get his life back on track just as zombies start to roam the streets of London to feast on the living. Comedy horror, with Simon Pegg and Nick Frost.

videos.title: Hot Fuzz
videos.description: A zealous policeman is relocated to a sleepy country village, where a series of grisly so-called accidents arouses his suspicions. Action comedy, starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost.

videos.title: The World's End
videos.description: Five childhood friends reunite for a pub crawl in their home town, only to stumble on a threat to the entire human race. Sci-fi comedy, with Simon Pegg and Nick Frost.

videos.title: Just Friends
videos.description: A music executive tries to woo the love of his high-school years, who saw the once overweight and fumbling schoolboy only as a friend. Comedy, starring Ryan Reynolds and Amy Smart.

videos.title: Little Fockers
videos.description: A father of twins invites his family to his kids' birthday party and tries to finally prove his worth to his father-in-law. Comedy sequel, with Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro.

videos.title: Superbad
videos.description: Two teenagers hope to lose their virginity at a party - but to get into the bash they must take booze, which proves harder than expected. Comedy, with Jonah Hill and Michael Cera.

videos.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
videos.description: A racing champion is forced to move back in with his mother after losing his title and wife, and battles to rebuild his confidence. Comedy, with Will Ferrell and John C Reilly.

videos.title: 21 Jump Street
videos.description: Two youthful-looking cops are sent undercover as high-school students to bring down a drugs ring. Comedy inspired by the 1980s TV series, starring Jonah Hill and Channing Tatum.

videos.title: 22 Jump Street
videos.description: Two cops are sent undercover at a university, but their friendship is threatened as they join different student cliques. Crime comedy, with Jonah Hill and Channing Tatum.

videos.title: Anaconda
videos.description: Friends encounter a terrifying creature while remaking a movie they have been wanting to shoot since childhood. Comedy adventure, starring Jack Black and Paul Rudd.

videos.title: Central Intelligence
videos.description: A rogue CIA agent turns to an old classmate for help when he is targeted by his own organisation. Action comedy, starring Dwayne Johnson and Kevin Hart.

videos.title: 50 First Dates
videos.description: A vet falls in love with a woman who suffers from short-term memory loss and forgets him after each of their encounters. Romantic comedy, starring Drew Barrymore and Adam Sandler.

videos.title: Big Daddy
videos.description: An immature man takes care of his flatmate's five-year-old son to prove to his former girlfriend he can handle responsibility. Comedy, starring Adam Sandler and Joey Lauren Adams.

videos.title: The Phoenician Scheme
videos.description: A rich businessman and his daughter become the target of scheming tycoons, terrorists and assassins. Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro.

videos.title: Instant Family
videos.description: A couple decide to adopt, but get more than they bargained for when they take in a rebellious teen and her two siblings. Comedy, starring Mark Wahlberg and Rose Byrne.

videos.title: Hitch
videos.description: A professional relationship guru finds his expertise counts for nothing when he ends up falling in love himself. Romantic comedy, starring Will Smith, Eva Mendes and Kevin James.

videos.title: Zoolander 2
videos.description: A dim-witted supermodel must step back into the spotlight when a maniac starts murdering some of the world's most beautiful pop stars. Comedy sequel, starring Ben Stiller.

videos.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
videos.description: A chauvinistic newsreader faces a battle of the sexes when an ambitious female reporter threatens his status. Comedy set in the 1970s, starring Will Ferrell and Christina Applegate.

videos.description: A teenager whose parents forgot her birthday searches for the man of her dreams. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald and Justin Henry.

videos.description: The arrival of secretive neighbours sparks curiosity in a group of friends, who go to bizarre lengths to learn the truth about them. Black comedy, with Tom Hanks and Bruce Dern.
